we identified nine different mutations (including 2 novel frameshift mutations) in 14 Korean LFS patients, and that there was considerable heterogeneity of TP53 mutations and tumors in Korean LFS patients.
we identified a total of 14 patients with Li-Frumaneni syndrome (LFS), and that the median age at the time of the diagnosis of the first tumor was 25 years.

we identified 14 LFS mutation carriers from 89 Korean individuals with cancer, and the most common mutation was p.Arg273His (n=4) in the TP53 gene, which was followed by p.Arg175His (n=3), p.Val31Ise (n=2) and p.Pro27Leuf*17 (n=2).
